title: Refuse unauthenticated and excess sessions
description:
As the maintainer, I want only the student to start sessions.

Feature: Access control
  Scenario: Unauthenticated start is refused
    When a session is requested without credentials
    Then the response is 401
  Scenario: Only one concurrent session
    Given an active session for the student
    When a second session is requested
    Then the request is refused

comments.author: home
comments.text: Deployed; 401 without a token verified. Excess-session behavior awaits a real signed-in run.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Unauthenticated requests get 401 on the deployed control and proxy URLs (checked live). One-session-per-user and the global cap are covered by specs; races tracked in SIE-860166.

right_now_summary: Unauthenticated access is blocked, but excess-session behavior still needs a signed-in test.
